thread:
noah: Quick spur-of-the-moment: office playoff pool + pizza for Friday night? Small $3 buy-in just for bragging rights and a pizza slice pledge. :pizza: :crown:

rachael: I'm in. What are the rules for the pool? Single-elim winner picks toppings?

own: Single-match picks only. Winner gets the pizza crown and one free slice from the office stash. $3 via Venmo to @noah.

ben: I'll participate if someone gets veggie-friendly pizza (no jalapeos on mine pls).

kira: Veggie noted. Also we should coordinate pizza count based on attendance.

noah: Tentative plan: order two large pies + one gluten-free. Vote on toppings: pepperoni, margherita, veggie. Reply with number 1/2/3.

supply-bot: Office snacks budget check: auto-approve under $40. Please attach receipt to #finance-snacks.

rachael: 3

own: 2

ben: 3 (but half pepperoni if possible)

kira: 1 for me

noah: Tally so far: pepperoni=1, margherita=1, veggie=2. Ordering 2 large (1 pepperoni, 1 veggie) + 1 GF margherita. Confirming gluten-free + veggie options.

ben: Also, small fantasy sidenote: I dropped a double-trade earlier, anyone watching the waiver? Might pick up a streamer for next week.

rachael: I can watch waivers. If anything juicy pops up, I'll ping the group.

noah: Final buy-in list: noah, rachael, owen, ben, kira -> $3 each. Noah collecting. Pickup at 7:15pm, party in breakroom at 7:30.

supply-bot: Reminder: allocate $15 from snack budget to reimburse organizer if receipt uploaded.

ben: Venmo sent. Thanks for organizing noah.

kira: Sent too. See y'all Friday! :v:

own: Thanks everyone, will post receipt after pickup. Winner gets the mock crown and a custom slack emoji for a week.

rachael: Looking forward to the crown. May the best pick win. :crossed_fingers:
